{"referents":[{"id":"r_su","mentions":[{"paragraph":5,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":13,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":16,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":27,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":30,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":39,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":49,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":59,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":74,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":76,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_codex","mentions":[{"paragraph":6,"text":"低沉言语","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":7,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":13,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":20,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":28,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":29,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":44,"text":"星界使者","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":49,"text":"小破书","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":64,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":73,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_body","mentions":[{"paragraph":7,"text":"陌生的娇小身影","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":8,"text":"毛茸茸的耳朵","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":10,"text":"一只娇小的金毛狐女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":11,"text":"乖巧可爱的毛茸茸金毛狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":16,"text":"炸毛大尾巴","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":17,"text":"两只耳朵","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":32,"text":"娇小身影","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":33,"text":"白皙软嫩带着红晕的小脚","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":35,"text":"现在的身体","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":40,"text":"这副身体","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":52,"text":"金毛狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_tai","mentions":[{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":1,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_owner","mentions":[{"paragraph":40,"text":"原来的主人","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_creator","mentions":[{"paragraph":66,"text":"造物主","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_role","mentions":[{"paragraph":63,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":66,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":67,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_contract","mentions":[{"paragraph":44,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":58,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":61,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":75,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d_author","from":2,"to":2,"text":"作者声明：本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p4","from":4,"to":4,"text":"有人要求提供姓名：姓名。","channel":"voice","mode":"request","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p5","from":5,"to":5,"text":"有女声回答：苏天晴。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p6","from":6,"to":6,"text":"昏暗房间中传出清脆悦耳的女声和一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p7","from":7,"to":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，并从落地镜中瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p8_11","from":8,"to":11,"text":"镜中身影有灿烂金色长发、毛茸茸耳朵和精致五官；她是一只娇小的金毛狐女，若加上背后正在炸毛的大尾巴，便像乖巧可爱的毛茸茸金毛狐狐。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p12","from":12,"to":12,"text":"古书低声说：嗯嗯……这样啊……","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":[]},{"id":"d_p13","from":13,"to":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，使苏天晴把注意力转回眼前的黑色古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p14","from":14,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴感到茫然。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p15","from":15,"to":15,"text":"苏天晴回忆五分钟前：她结束连续三个夜班下班，在街边面摊吃加煎蛋的牛肉面并加辣椒面，突然听到太奶在背后说话；回头看见太奶坐藤椅编围巾，随即胸口一疼、眼前一黑，背过气去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p16","from":16,"to":16,"text":"苏天晴看着身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，鬼使神差地伸手在尾巴上用力薅了一把。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p17","from":17,"to":17,"text":"手上传来无比柔顺的绝妙触感，同时一股陌生的摩挲拉拽感从尾巴尖直冲天灵盖，惊得两只耳朵猛然竖起，整只狐绷直了身体。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p18","from":18,"to":18,"text":"苏天晴心想：好真实的触感！","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p19","from":19,"to":19,"text":"古书问：你干嘛呢。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p20","from":20,"to":20,"text":"黑色古书发出低沉言语，不明白眼前狐狐为什么要突然用怪异手法去薅她自己的尾巴。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p21","from":21,"to":21,"text":"古书心想：不疼的吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p22_23","from":22,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止古书继续说话，并说：等一下，稍等一下！她眼珠一转，飞快理清思绪。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p24_26","from":24,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴心想：我重生了，重生成一只金毛狐女；那么眼前这本黑色会说话的书是怎么回事？有人能给我解释一下吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_body","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p27","from":27,"to":27,"text":"苏天晴扭头正视古书，茫然地问：你是谁？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p28","from":28,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默了一会儿，像是在思考眼前呆头呆脑的狐狐是不是自己要找的人，良久后重复了一遍两分钟前的开场白。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_p29","from":29,"to":29,"text":"古书说：吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p30","from":30,"to":30,"text":"古书说：而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p31","from":31,"to":31,"text":"再次听完这中二台词，苏天晴又陷入沉默与思索。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p32","from":32,"to":32,"text":"狐狐猛地从床上蹦下，走到落地镜前，沉默地看向镜中穿着宽松睡裙的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p33","from":33,"to":33,"text":"她抬起一只脚，认真欣赏起这只白皙软嫩带着红晕的小脚。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p34","from":34,"to":34,"text":"苏天晴心想：嗯，完美，绝品。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p35","from":35,"to":35,"text":"古书说：看来你对现在的身体很满意嘛。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p36","from":36,"to":36,"text":"古书瞅见狐狐认真欣赏脚丫，一时语塞，憋了半天才冒出这一句。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_p37","from":37,"to":37,"text":"古书问：但是你为什么要盯着脚看？正常情况下不应该是……","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p38","from":38,"to":38,"text":"苏天晴回答：你不懂，小脚才是世界上最美好的瑰宝，吃饭的时候看见了都能多炫两碗。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p39","from":39,"to":39,"text":"苏天晴嘴上不搭调地回答古书，脑子里却对现状有了大概了解。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p40","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴心想：这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人，难道说……","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p41","from":41,"to":41,"text":"古书说：既然你这么满意，那咱们可以直接快进到下个步骤了。","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p42","from":42,"to":42,"text":"古书说道，将欣赏狐狐身躯的苏天晴从发癫中唤回，苏天晴转身正视它。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_p43","from":43,"to":43,"text":"古书说：听着，苏天晴。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p44","from":44,"to":44,"text":"古书说：你是墨丘利秘典的最佳适格者，作为星界使者，我会引导你走上完美的生活，而你只需要与我签订一个小小的契约——","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p45","from":45,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴说：好，我签。","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p46","from":46,"to":46,"text":"古书说：……啊？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":[]},{"id":"d_p47","from":47,"to":47,"text":"古书凌乱了一下。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p48","from":48,"to":48,"text":"古书问：不是，你不按套路出牌啊，契约怎么说签就签的？都不犹豫考虑一下吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p49","from":49,"to":49,"text":"苏天晴严肃地说：这就是你思想狭隘了，小破书。这让古书一时忘记了刚才那奇怪的称呼。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p50","from":50,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴问：我问你，世界上最通用的愿望是哪两个。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_p51","from":51,"to":51,"text":"古书愣愣地反问：……哪两个？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":[]},{"id":"d_p52","from":52,"to":52,"text":"金毛狐狐俯下身子，在黑色古书面前伸出两根手指轻轻晃动，身后毛茸茸大尾巴也随之摇曳。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p53","from":53,"to":53,"text":"苏天晴说：取之不尽的财富！以及变成萝莉！这是世界上最通用的两个愿望！","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_p54","from":54,"to":54,"text":"苏天晴张开双臂，满眼放光。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p55","from":55,"to":55,"text":"苏天晴说：变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐！","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p56","from":56,"to":56,"text":"沉默。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p57","from":57,"to":57,"text":"古书觉得好像有哪里很对又根本不对，但未错乱太久，迅速把话题拖回正题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p58","from":58,"to":58,"text":"古书问：既然你答应，那我们之间的契约就算成立了？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p59","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴不假思索地说：成立。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p60","from":60,"to":60,"text":"狐狐突然反应过来什么，好奇地问。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p61","from":61,"to":61,"text":"苏天晴问：那个……我能问问契约的具体内容吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p62","from":62,"to":62,"text":"苏天晴心想：总不能是激活了什么奇怪的奴隶契约吧！那样的话可就亏大发了！","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p63","from":63,"to":63,"text":"古书没有丝毫停顿地说：反派魔法少女。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p64","from":64,"to":64,"text":"古书这般说道。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p65","from":65,"to":65,"text":"苏天晴说：啊？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_p66","from":66,"to":66,"text":"古书说：既然契约已经签订，那么从今天开始，你就将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主给你量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助你逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点！","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_contract","r_role"]},{"id":"d_p67","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴问：不是、等一下！魔法少女是怎么回事！是那种死亡率高达90%的高危职业吗？！","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p68","from":68,"to":68,"text":"古书说：放心吧，是王道系的那种。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p69","from":69,"to":69,"text":"苏天晴问：就是这样才不对吧！在王道故事里当反派不是纯纯的找死吗！","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p70","from":70,"to":70,"text":"苏天晴突然有点后悔了。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p71","from":71,"to":71,"text":"苏天晴心想：王道系是魔法少女们面对强敌逐渐成长，然后喊着友情和羁绊冲上去把反派干碎的那种故事；就算反派有系统有任务，也很难在王道系故事里把主角干碎。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p72","from":72,"to":72,"text":"苏天晴心想：我还能有反悔的机会吗？能不能把我送回原来的身体里？我觉得急性心肌梗死还有抢救的机会——","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p73","from":73,"to":73,"text":"脑海中响起系统提示：墨丘利秘典绑定成功。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex","r_su","r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p74","from":74,"to":74,"text":"脑子里响起的声音让苏天晴欲哭无泪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p75","from":75,"to":75,"text":"系统提示：契约成立。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p76","from":76,"to":76,"text":"古书说：走上反派魔法少女的道路吧，苏天晴。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_role"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b1","from":1,"to":3,"gist":"标题、作者关于角色均已满18岁的声明与分隔线。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b2","from":4,"to":6,"gist":"昏暗房间中有声音询问姓名，女声回答苏天晴；房中有女声和一道低沉言语。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"b3","from":7,"to":7,"gist":"苏天晴坐在床头，看着飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，并从落地镜中瞥见陌生的娇小身影。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"b4","from":8,"to":11,"gist":"描述镜中金毛狐女的外貌：金色长发、毛茸茸耳朵、精致五官，以及炸毛大尾巴，加上便像乖巧可爱的金毛狐狐。","mode":"description","about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"b5","from":12,"to":18,"gist":"古书低声回应；苏天晴把注意力转回古书，回忆前世死亡，又因薅狐尾而体验真实触感。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"b6","from":19,"to":31,"gist":"古书问苏天晴为何薅自己尾巴；苏天晴尴尬理清重生后询问古书身份；古书自称墨丘利秘典，并称苏天晴是最优秀适格者。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"b7","from":32,"to":38,"gist":"苏天晴下床照镜并欣赏小脚，称小脚是瑰宝；古书对她盯脚看感到语塞。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"b8","from":39,"to":45,"gist":"苏天晴意识到古书知道她不是原身体主人；古书提出签订契约引导她走上完美生活，苏天晴立刻答应。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body","r_owner","r_contract"]},{"id":"b9","from":46,"to":57,"gist":"古书惊讶苏天晴不按套路；苏天晴称取之不尽的财富和变成萝莉是通用愿望，并满眼放光；古书被绕晕后拖回正题。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body","r_contract"]},{"id":"b10","from":58,"to":62,"gist":"古书确认契约成立，苏天晴不假思索答应，随后好奇询问契约具体内容，并担心是奴隶契约。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_contract"]},{"id":"b11","from":63,"to":76,"gist":"古书揭示契约是成为反派魔法少女，称造物主为她定制任务；苏天晴后悔质疑，但墨丘利秘典绑定成功，契约成立，古书命她走上反派魔法少女道路。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_contract","r_role","r_creator"]}]}

{"referents":[{"id":"r_su","mentions":[{"paragraph":5,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":13,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":16,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":27,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":30,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":39,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":49,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":59,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":74,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":76,"text":"苏天晴","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_codex","mentions":[{"paragraph":6,"text":"低沉言语","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":7,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":13,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":20,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":28,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":29,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":44,"text":"星界使者","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":49,"text":"小破书","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":64,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":73,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_body","mentions":[{"paragraph":7,"text":"陌生的娇小身影","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":8,"text":"毛茸茸的耳朵","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":10,"text":"一只娇小的金毛狐女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":11,"text":"乖巧可爱的毛茸茸金毛狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":16,"text":"炸毛大尾巴","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":17,"text":"两只耳朵","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":32,"text":"娇小身影","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":33,"text":"白皙软嫩带着红晕的小脚","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":35,"text":"现在的身体","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":40,"text":"这副身体","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":52,"text":"金毛狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_tai","mentions":[{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":1,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_owner","mentions":[{"paragraph":40,"text":"原来的主人","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_creator","mentions":[{"paragraph":66,"text":"造物主","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_role","mentions":[{"paragraph":63,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":66,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":67,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_contract","mentions":[{"paragraph":44,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":58,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":61,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":75,"text":"契约","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d_author","from":2,"to":2,"text":"作者声明：本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p4","from":4,"to":4,"text":"有人要求提供姓名：姓名。","channel":"voice","mode":"request","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p5","from":5,"to":5,"text":"有女声回答：苏天晴。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p6","from":6,"to":6,"text":"昏暗房间中传出清脆悦耳的女声和一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p7","from":7,"to":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，并从落地镜中瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p8_11","from":8,"to":11,"text":"镜中身影有灿烂金色长发、毛茸茸耳朵和精致五官；她是一只娇小的金毛狐女，若加上背后正在炸毛的大尾巴，便像乖巧可爱的毛茸茸金毛狐狐。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p12","from":12,"to":12,"text":"古书低声说：嗯嗯……这样啊……","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":[]},{"id":"d_p13","from":13,"to":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，使苏天晴把注意力转回眼前的黑色古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p14","from":14,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴感到茫然。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p15","from":15,"to":15,"text":"苏天晴回忆五分钟前：她结束连续三个夜班下班，在街边面摊吃加煎蛋的牛肉面并加辣椒面，突然听到太奶在背后说话；回头看见太奶坐藤椅编围巾，随即胸口一疼、眼前一黑，背过气去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p16","from":16,"to":16,"text":"苏天晴看着身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，鬼使神差地伸手在尾巴上用力薅了一把。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p17","from":17,"to":17,"text":"手上传来无比柔顺的绝妙触感，同时一股陌生的摩挲拉拽感从尾巴尖直冲天灵盖，惊得两只耳朵猛然竖起，整只狐绷直了身体。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p18","from":18,"to":18,"text":"苏天晴心想：好真实的触感！","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p19","from":19,"to":19,"text":"古书问：你干嘛呢。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p20","from":20,"to":20,"text":"黑色古书发出低沉言语，不明白眼前狐狐为什么要突然用怪异手法去薅她自己的尾巴。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p21","from":21,"to":21,"text":"古书心想：不疼的吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p22_23","from":22,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止古书继续说话，并说：等一下，稍等一下！她眼珠一转，飞快理清思绪。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p24_26","from":24,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴心想：我重生了，重生成一只金毛狐女；那么眼前这本黑色会说话的书是怎么回事？有人能给我解释一下吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_body","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p27","from":27,"to":27,"text":"苏天晴扭头正视古书，茫然地问：你是谁？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p28","from":28,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默了一会儿，像是在思考眼前呆头呆脑的狐狐是不是自己要找的人，良久后重复了一遍两分钟前的开场白。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_p29","from":29,"to":29,"text":"古书说：吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p30","from":30,"to":30,"text":"古书说：而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p31","from":31,"to":31,"text":"再次听完这中二台词，苏天晴又陷入沉默与思索。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p32","from":32,"to":32,"text":"狐狐猛地从床上蹦下，走到落地镜前，沉默地看向镜中穿着宽松睡裙的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p33","from":33,"to":33,"text":"她抬起一只脚，认真欣赏起这只白皙软嫩带着红晕的小脚。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p34","from":34,"to":34,"text":"苏天晴心想：嗯，完美，绝品。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p35","from":35,"to":35,"text":"古书说：看来你对现在的身体很满意嘛。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p36","from":36,"to":36,"text":"古书瞅见狐狐认真欣赏脚丫，一时语塞，憋了半天才冒出这一句。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_p37","from":37,"to":37,"text":"古书问：但是你为什么要盯着脚看？正常情况下不应该是……","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p38","from":38,"to":38,"text":"苏天晴回答：你不懂，小脚才是世界上最美好的瑰宝，吃饭的时候看见了都能多炫两碗。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p39","from":39,"to":39,"text":"苏天晴嘴上不搭调地回答古书，脑子里却对现状有了大概了解。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p40","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴心想：这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人，难道说……","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p41","from":41,"to":41,"text":"古书说：既然你这么满意，那咱们可以直接快进到下个步骤了。","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p42","from":42,"to":42,"text":"古书说道，将欣赏狐狐身躯的苏天晴从发癫中唤回，苏天晴转身正视它。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_p43","from":43,"to":43,"text":"古书说：听着，苏天晴。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p44","from":44,"to":44,"text":"古书说：你是墨丘利秘典的最佳适格者，作为星界使者，我会引导你走上完美的生活，而你只需要与我签订一个小小的契约——","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p45","from":45,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴说：好，我签。","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p46","from":46,"to":46,"text":"古书说：……啊？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":[]},{"id":"d_p47","from":47,"to":47,"text":"古书凌乱了一下。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p48","from":48,"to":48,"text":"古书问：不是，你不按套路出牌啊，契约怎么说签就签的？都不犹豫考虑一下吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p49","from":49,"to":49,"text":"苏天晴严肃地说：这就是你思想狭隘了，小破书。这让古书一时忘记了刚才那奇怪的称呼。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p50","from":50,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴问：我问你，世界上最通用的愿望是哪两个。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_p51","from":51,"to":51,"text":"古书愣愣地反问：……哪两个？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":[]},{"id":"d_p52","from":52,"to":52,"text":"金毛狐狐俯下身子，在黑色古书面前伸出两根手指轻轻晃动，身后毛茸茸大尾巴也随之摇曳。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex","r_body"]},{"id":"d_p53","from":53,"to":53,"text":"苏天晴说：取之不尽的财富！以及变成萝莉！这是世界上最通用的两个愿望！","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_p54","from":54,"to":54,"text":"苏天晴张开双臂，满眼放光。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p55","from":55,"to":55,"text":"苏天晴说：变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐！","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body"]},{"id":"d_p56","from":56,"to":56,"text":"沉默。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_p57","from":57,"to":57,"text":"古书觉得好像有哪里很对又根本不对，但未错乱太久，迅速把话题拖回正题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p58","from":58,"to":58,"text":"古书问：既然你答应，那我们之间的契约就算成立了？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p59","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴不假思索地说：成立。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p60","from":60,"to":60,"text":"狐狐突然反应过来什么，好奇地问。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p61","from":61,"to":61,"text":"苏天晴问：那个……我能问问契约的具体内容吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p62","from":62,"to":62,"text":"苏天晴心想：总不能是激活了什么奇怪的奴隶契约吧！那样的话可就亏大发了！","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p63","from":63,"to":63,"text":"古书没有丝毫停顿地说：反派魔法少女。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_contract"]},{"id":"d_p64","from":64,"to":64,"text":"古书这般说道。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_p65","from":65,"to":65,"text":"苏天晴说：啊？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_p66","from":66,"to":66,"text":"古书说：既然契约已经签订，那么从今天开始，你就将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主给你量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助你逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点！","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_contract","r_role"]},{"id":"d_p67","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴问：不是、等一下！魔法少女是怎么回事！是那种死亡率高达90%的高危职业吗？！","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p68","from":68,"to":68,"text":"古书说：放心吧，是王道系的那种。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p69","from":69,"to":69,"text":"苏天晴问：就是这样才不对吧！在王道故事里当反派不是纯纯的找死吗！","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_role"]},{"id":"d_p70","from":70,"to":70,"text":"苏天晴突然有点后悔了。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_p71","from":71,"to":71,"text":"苏天晴心想：王道系是魔法少女们面对强敌逐渐成长，然后喊着友情和羁绊冲上去把反派干碎的那种故事；就算反派有系统有任务，也很难在王道系故事里把主角干碎。","channel":"thought
